messages:
Leo: opened a draft PR for the offline repo & GPG rotation section. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/489
docs-bot: Leo opened PR #489 — title: 'Offline-package-mirror: apt/yum proxy, repo signing, and key rotation notes'
Priya: nice. can we include an example for signed-by in apt sources.list.d? apt-key is deprecated and a lot of customers hit this when importing keys in airgapped envs
Leo: good call. I added an example that writes the key to /usr/share/keyrings/redwood-offline-archive.gpg and references it with signed-by. snippet in PR
Priya: can you paste that snippet here so I can sanity-check the syntax?
Leo: sure:
Leo: ```bash
# import release key into a keyring file
sudo gpg --no-default-keyring --keyring /usr/share/keyrings/redwood-offline-archive.gpg --import redwood-offline-release.gpg
# apt source entry
echo "deb [signed-by=/usr/share/keyrings/redwood-offline-archive.gpg] file:/mnt/offline/repo stable main" | sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/redwood-offline.list
```
Jacob: looks good. maybe add a note about permission bits — apt will refuse a keyring that's writable by group/other. recommend 0644 and owned by root
Leo: added file permission note to the doc
Ops-Infra: for yum/dnf we should show both gpgkey file path and the rpm --import flow for airgapped hosts. some customers prefer placing the .asc in /etc/pki/rpm-gpg/ and using gpgcheck=1
Priya: also call out createrepo_c vs createrepo performance differences for large bundles. createrepo_c is faster and we use it in the offline bundle generation scripts
Leo: added createrepo_c note and example command:
Leo: ```bash
createrepo_c /mnt/offline/repo && rsync -av --delete /mnt/offline/repo /mirror/redwood-repo/
```
Priya: another edge case — apt in some older Ubuntu images requires the file:// path to be absolute and not have trailing slashes; added a one-liner to warn customers
Jacob: security nit: recommend verifying the GPG key fingerprint out-of-band before trusting it. can we add the fingerprint string in the release assets page and link to it from the doc?
Leo: I'll add a release-assets note and include the fingerprint and sha256 sums. also included a small verification example:
Leo: ```bash
# verify bundle signature
gpg --no-default-keyring --keyring /usr/share/keyrings/redwood-offline-archive.gpg --verify redwood-offline-bundle.tar.gz.sig redwood-offline-bundle.tar.gz
# verify checksum
sha256sum -c redwood-offline-bundle.tar.gz.sha256
```
Ops-Infra: one more: proxy config for apt/yum in airgapped customer setups that still use a local proxy. example for apt: /etc/apt/apt.conf.d/01proxy with Acquire::http::Proxy "http://10.0.0.5:3128/". add a yum.conf proxy example too
Priya: Regarding key rotation: include a short migration guide for customers who need to rotate the GPG key used for repository signing — steps to sign new metadata, publish both keys during transition, and then retire old key after X days. put this in a "rotation checklist" section
Leo: wrote a concise rotation checklist and added a sample systemd timer to automate metadata regeneration on the mirror host (for customers who schedule nightly bundle refreshes). also corrected a prior example where the systemd unit name was referenced as redwood-repo-syncd — changed to redwood-repo-sync to match the packaged artifact
Jacob: please ensure the doc mentions the SELinux context tweaks for RHEL hosts serving the file:// repo — customers hit permission denied otherwise (chcon -t httpd_sys_content_t for http-served mirrors)
Leo: included SELinux notes and linked to our internal selinux-guide snippet
docs-bot: PR #489 updated by Leo (files changed: 6)
Leo: requesting review from @Priya and @Ops-Infra. plan to merge after one more pass and CI green :white_check_mark:
Priya: will review tonight. main ask is that the migration checklist includes an explicit rollback step and example commands for re-signing metadata if a rotation fails
Ops-Infra: lgtm pending the yum proxy example and the fingerprint being added to the release assets page
Leo: thanks — I'll push those two items and run the docs sample-run check before merge
docs-bot: Reminder: docs CI checks queued (lint, links, sample-run)
Leo: CI passed on last push, merging tomorrow morning unless anyone objects
